failureMessage: KRALİ araştırma kalitesini iyileştir (developer.suggestion.research.3ae07532-332) native local agent iteration sınırına ulaştı.

diagnosis.summary: local_agent_iteration_limit happened because this gap is a seeded fallback with no failing runtime/oracle, so the agent burned budget surveying research code without a converging mutation; the smallest in-scope atomic fix is to consume unused preferredSourceKinds during web result scoring/diversity so source-kind diversity actually drives selection.

rootCauseHypotheses.hypothesis: The approved gap is a discoverability seed (fingerprint fallback:research-quality), not a localized failing contract: zero strategy candidates, no runtime error lines, no resolver trace, and development_research_quality self-tests already PASS—so the local agent exhausted iterations on read/search without selecting a trustworthy mutation target.
evidence: Brief reports strategy candidates Yok, combined evidence count 1, empty runtime source hints, and no matching resolver trace

Historical pattern in KRALI_DEVELOPMENT_NOTES: vague foundation tasks consume iteration budget on inspection with no candidate

rootCauseHypotheses.hypothesis: Source-diversity intent is under-implemented at the selection seam: AgentResearchQueryPlanner.developmentPlan writes preferredSourceKinds on each AgentDevelopmentResearchFacet, but no consumer reads that field; AgentWebResearch.selectDiverseResults only caps by domain, while AgentDevelopmentResearchVerifier only checks independent origins/Tier A/B counts—so kind diversity never becomes an atomic selection behavior.

Workspace search shows preferredSourceKinds is never referenced outside those two declarations
AgentWebResearch.relevanceEvaluation boosts Tier via AgentDevelopmentResearchSourceClassifier.assess but never rewards preferredSourceKinds coverage
selectDiverseResults diversifies solely via domainCounts (first unique domain, then max 2/domain)
Verifier gaps track independent origins / Tier A/B / facet evidence coverage, not preferred kind coverage

rootCauseHypotheses.hypothesis: Evidence-binding quality is already enforced downstream (Tier A/B evidenceIDs on approaches/proposal in AgentLocalIntelligence.synthesizeSelfDevelopmentResearch + AgentDevelopmentResearchVerifier); without a failing binding oracle, patching synthesis first is unlikely to be the minimal gap and easily burns remaining iteration budget.
evidence: AgentLocalIntelligence.synthesizeSelfDevelopmentResearch refuses synthesis when Tier A/B evidence is empty and validates evidence ID sets
AgentDevelopmentResearchVerifier rejects unsupported approaches/proposals lacking qualifying external evidenceIDs
allowSnippetEvidence:false is already required by self-development research policy for development research page grounding

Extend selectDiverseResults (or an adjacent development-only selector) to prefer distinct AgentResearchSourceKind / canonicalOrigin pairs before filling remaining slots by domain—keep Tier A/B and mutation-off verifier semantics unchanged.

If still short of the approved benefit, only then tighten evidence↔facet binding helpers inside AgentDevelopmentResearch / AgentLocalIntelligence (e.g. prefer binding one qualifying evidence ID per required facet) without rewriting staged synthesis.
Do not retarget AgentEngine.researchLoop early-exit or Mentors/CI/runner files; they are forbidden and not required for this atomic diversity seam.
